about: Known-open failures of scripts/release_gate.py on main, keyed by statement id (see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, 'The release gate'). Each entry lists the DuckDB versions and backends it fails on. A run fails on a failure not listed here and on a listed entry that now passes: remove entries as their fix merges. Areas were attributed by which fix branch clears each statement where a branch run covered it, by heuristics otherwise.

count_if-null.fix: none yet: open, found by this gate on 2026-11-26
count_if-null.what: count_if(x) over a group whose x is all NULL: DuckDB returns NULL, the device returns 0 (every wrapper so far)

name-binding.what: An ORDER BY name that is both a select alias and a different column (or is qualified, or wrapped) binds to the other one on the device

settings.what: Failing in the settings mode with the setting changed on the statement's own connection; the failure itself is a literal or name hazard of the statement

settings-across-handles.what: A setting changed (or RESET) through a sibling cursor, a raw DuckDB cursor or SET GLOBAL is not seen by a cached decision

temporal-infinity.what: A TIMESTAMP / DATE holding infinity / -infinity becomes a NULL cell or a finite extreme on the device (global masked aggregates, min / max, comparisons)

where-literal.what: A WHERE literal the column type cannot hold (a fraction against an integer, a value out of range, 1e400, a FLOAT column against a DECIMAL / DOUBLE literal): wrong rows, or an internal exception (Decline, TypeError, OverflowError, InvalidInput) raised to the user, mostly on the re-run drawn by the Python renderer
